title: GoodRx Price Lookup Lowest Price Leaderboard
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goodrx:price lowest_price_usd=*
| stats sum(lowest_price_usd) as total_value, avg(lowest_price_usd) as avg_value by drug_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks drug values by total and average lowest price across GoodRx price lookup events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `lowest_price_usd` values for each GoodRx price lookup event and review total and average lowest price by drug.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total lowest price.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which drug shows the biggest lowest price numbers in your GoodRx price lookup data.
